Classroom simulation only. Queue-car positions are illustrative and do not represent individual vehicle trajectories. The timeline replays stored Python agent decisions (one record every 5 simulated seconds by default), not a real-time hardware feed. Evaluation results are separately computed across multiple held-out seeds; they are not the single replay run. Pedestrian target is an urgency threshold, not a guaranteed maximum.
